mapper.update: UPDATE hr_employee_advance SET advance_amount = #{plan.amount}, purpose = #{plan.purpose}, repay_mode = #{plan.repayMode}, repay_start_month = #{plan.repayStartMonth}, repay_months = #{plan.repayMonths}, monthly_deduct_amount = #{plan.monthlyDeductAmount}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND advance_id = #{advanceId} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'APPLYING' AND approval_status = 'DRAFT' AND instance_id IS NULL AND payment_request_id IS NULL AND paid_time IS NULL

UPDATE sys_file SET biz_type = 'HR_ADVANCE_PROOF', biz_id = #{advanceId}, file_hash = #{fileHash} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_ADVANCE_PROOF' AND create_by = #{owner} AND deleted = 0 AND access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND url = '' AND biz_type IS NULL AND biz_id IS NULL AND portal_owner_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_ADVANCE_PROOF' AND biz_type = 'HR_ADVANCE_PROOF' AND biz_id = #{advanceId} AND deleted = 0 AND access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND url = '' AND portal_owner_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM hr_advance_repayment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND proof_file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY repayment_id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM hr_employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS salary_slip_id, employee_id, period_month, status, reserved_settlement_id FROM hr_salary_slip WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{salarySlipId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT salary.* FROM hr_salary_slip salary INNER JOIN hr_payroll_correction correction ON correction.correction_slip_id = salary.id AND correction.tenant_id = salary.tenant_id AND correction.deleted = 0 WHERE salary.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND salary.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND salary.deleted = 0 AND salary.status IN ('PENDING', 'SUBMITTED') ORDER BY salary.id
